page.layout: Two medallion portraits with legends at the top, centred; below them one column of running text; below that a printed fleuron ornament. No marginal notes. Running head at top, page number at top right.

main_text.p: C. OCTAVIVS, pater Augusti, à principio ætatis, & re & æstimatione magna fuit: amplis innutritus opibus, honores & adeptus est facilè, & egregiè administrauit. Prætor Macedoniæ, fugitiuos, reliquam Spartaci & Catilinæ manum, in itinere deleuit. Prouinciæ præfuit non minore iustitia quàm fortitudine: nam Bessis ac Thracibus magno prælio fusis, ita socios tractauit, ut epistolæ Ciceronis extét, quibus Quintum fratre, eodem tempore parum secunda fama Procōsulatum Asiæ administrantem, hortatur & moner ut imitetur in promerendis sociis, vicinum suum, hunc inquam, Octauium. Decedens Macedonia priusquam confiteri se cādidatum Consulatus posset, morte obiit repetina, superstitibus liberis, Octauia maiore, quā ex Ancharia, & Octauia minore, item Octauio, nondum Augusto, quos ex Accia suscepérat. Cōsulito C. Suetonium Tranquillum in Augusti vita.

ACCIA, C. Octauij patris Augusti vxor, M. Accio Balbo, & Iulia, sorore C. Cæsaris, genita est. Balbus paterna stirpe Aricinus, multis in familia Senatoriis imaginibus clarus, à matre Magnum Pompeium arctissimo contingebat gradu: functús-que honore prætūrae, inter 20. viros agrum Campanum plebi, Iulia lege, diuisit. Suet. in Aug. fuit hæc Accia imperatoris Augusti mater.

page.notes: Medallion legends transcribed as printed; their exact placement around the coins is approximate, and the bottom letter of the left legend is doubtful. Faint show-through text in the middle of the page, between the paragraphs and under the second paragraph, is left out. The signature "Mm 3" overlaps show-through and is partly doubtful. "moner" is printed as such and may be a misprint for "monet". "suscepérat" is partly doubtful.
